_doc: How effects are scored and how much the plan resists change. weights: share of each factor in an effect's score. continuity: cost of changing effect and how strong musical transitions reduce it. decision: length of the windows effects are chosen for (seconds). random_amplitude: size of the seeded jitter. continuity.contrast_relief: how much a change in the music itself (not just a section boundary) lowers the cost of changing effect; the change is measured on the characteristics each prop's effects care about, relative to this song's own biggest changes (contrast_reference = the percentile used, 0.9). 0 turns it off. passes: the planning passes after the main one (DESIGN.md section 9) - top: role 'top' groups take over whole sections of these types (the members rest there); detail: role 'detail' groups (e.g. groups of submodels) and enabled submodels get accent effects above their parents, complement = score factor for the same effect family as the parent shows, rest = factor for 'transparent' (nothing on the detail layer); enhance: a second layer of sparse accents on the focal_count largest standalone props (or those with enhance: true), only where energy >= min_energy.

base._doc: Whole-yard moments (0.20): unison hits on strong section starts and drops, sweeps across the yard (left to right or back, by where props stand) in the bar before a strong section, call and response between the left and right halves at the start of quieter sections. per_minute: how many moments a minute at most. members: what the props' own effects do during a moment - 'cut' (they rest: only the moment shows), 'over' (they keep playing, the moment on top), 'under' (they keep playing and win; the moment shows where they rest); per prop or group: models targets.NAME.base_members, and targets.NAME.base = false leaves a prop out. escalation: how much more likely a moment is in each later repeat of a section (chorus 3 > chorus 1). effect: what a moment flashes.

variation._doc: One-aspect variations (0.20): an effect that would run past its maximum (durations) is divided every 'every' bars (on bar lines) and each part changes exactly one aspect from the part before - aspect 'auto' (direction and colour by turns; colour when the effect has no direction), 'color', 'direction' or 'effect' (the next best effect, colours kept).

critic._doc: Scores a whole plan to pick the best of several seeds (run --candidates N): fit x fit + variety x variety + repeats x repeats - issues x issues. candidates = how many seeds 'run' tries by default (1 = just the song's seed).

durations._doc: Shortest and longest an effect may last (0.20): a number is seconds, "N bars" / "N beats" follow the tempo, null = no limit. The most specific wins: effect, then family, then pass, then default. Under min, a segment is absorbed by its neighbour on the row (not across a section start); past max it is varied (passes.variation). Pinned segments, reactive plans and moments are exempt.
